summary: Describes the policies, procedures and history behind cooperation between IEEE 802 and the IETF, such as work on SNMP MIBs and AAA applications. It is informational. It was replaced by RFC 7241.

eli5.summary: Two clubs that build different parts of networks agreed on how to work together. This note writes down their rules and how they got friendly. A newer note replaced it.

questions: how do ieee 802 and ietf coordinate
